newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila suspends Air Philippines operation.
newsitem.headline: Manila suspends Air Philippines operation.

text.p: Philippine air safety officials said on Friday they had temporarily suspended the operations of domestic carrier Air Philippines after the discovery of broken parts in two of its aircraft.
"Effective yesterday, we have suspended the operation of Air Philippines," Crispin Cruz, assistant chief of the Air Transportation Office's (ATO) Aviation Safety Division, told reporters.
He said the suspension came after the ATO discovered broken parts in the main landing gear in two of Air Philippines' three Boeing 737s this week.
The faults were found during a routine inspection.
The newly formed airline, which is owned by a group of Filipino businessmen, also has four Japanese-made YS-11 turbo prop aircraft.
"We are conducting an investigation on all its aircraft," Cruz said. He declined to say when the investigation would be completed and the suspension lifted.
Air Philippines officials were not immediately available for comment.
